body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The fleet extensions and status test suites (extensions.test.mjs, status-schema.test.mjs, status.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync and manage fixture cleanups via manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync or server closes, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t, and server tear-down can be scheduled via t.after.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/fleet/test/extensions.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update test declarations creating temp directories to accept t.
   - Replace all mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix) (e.g. realpathSync(tmp(t, prefix)) where realpath is needed).
   - Schedule proxy teardown via t.after(() => proxy.close()).
   - Remove all manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync, unindenting test bodies.
2. In packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update tests creating fixtures to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'adlc-fleet-schema-').
3. In packages/fleet/test/status.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update tmp(t) helper to accept t and delegate to tmp(t, 'fleet-status-').
   - Update test declarations calling tmp() to accept t and pass t to tmp(t).
4. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove 'packages/fleet/test/extensions.test.mjs', 'packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs', and 'packages/fleet/test/status.test.mjs' from the ALLOWLIST set.
5. Verification:
   - node --test packages/fleet/test/extensions.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' packages/fleet/test/extensions.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status.test.mjs outputs 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/fleet/test/extensions.test.mjs, status-schema.test.mjs, and status.test.mjs contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 3 test files.
- AC3 None of the 3 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 node --test packages/fleet/test/extensions.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(fleet): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in extensions and status tests
